prompt: A monumental classic rubber duck standing as a towering centrepiece on a darkened editorial set, rendered in a warm muted gold matte porcelain finish with an aged-paper quality — never warm amber finish, never saturated. The duck has the identical classic silhouette shared across the entire range: rounded body, soft cheek swell, gently upturned tail, small flat feet, and short flat bill. A plain oval pupil sits in each eye with no decorative glint, no catchlight, no sparkle. The camera is positioned low and slightly off-axis, looking up at the duck to amplify its monumentality, hero pattern A. The seamless backdrop is a deep warm near-black (#0E0B08), soft and tonally flat, with no horizon line. Lighting is editorial: a single soft window source from camera left, very gentle, casting long, low-contrast shadows across the duck's body, with a whisper of fill on the right cheek. The surface reads like bisque porcelain, not glossy resin. Aspect 16:9, full-bleed, no props, no text.
